lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi there! This is Lana, I'm an AI assistant calling for a patient. Just so you know, this call's recorded. How much is comprehensive braces treatment at your office?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Is there a separate records fee for x-rays and scans?

lines.speaker: clinic
lines.text: No, there's no records fee, x-rays and scans are included.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great, and what else does the $4,200 cover?

lines.speaker: clinic
lines.text: It covers the braces, all adjustment visits, x-rays and scans, and one set of retainers.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: If the patient pays monthly, how much would each payment be?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And how much is the down payment for that plan?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: When is your next available consult appointment?

lines.speaker: clinic
lines.text: We have Friday, October 30 at 7:30 AM or Tuesday, November 3 at 10:00 AM. Want me to book one?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you, the patient is comparing options first, so we'll call back. Do you have any evening appointments?

lines.speaker: clinic
lines.text: No, we close at 4 PM, so no evening appointments.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That's everything I needed, thank you so much for your help. Have a great day!
